用我的直接搞起来，rust ，极低内存占用，除了未完善的 Trace Explorer 会导致固定内存涨到 1000 条 item 的用量外，基本上完全可以随便搭配工具 ： https://v2ex.com/t/1222071#reply3

codex 我的配置：
```
[model_providers.ingress-access-1]
name = "RelayForge-access-1"
base_url = "http://127.0.0.1:33300/v1"
wire_api = "responses"
experimental_bearer_token = "no-api-key"

[model_providers.ingress-access-2]
name = "RelayForge-access-2"
base_url = "http://127.0.0.1:33301/v1"
wire_api = "responses"
experimental_bearer_token = "no-api-key"
```
